• Hang the paper clips from the string loop as shown in Fig. 1.4.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Vary M. The total mass M may be made from slotted masses only or from m and slotted
masses. For each value of M, measure and record M, θ and L. Repeat until you have six sets
of values.
Record your results in a table. Include values of e and sinθ in your table.

parts.text: Plot a graph of e on the y‑axis against sinθ on the x‑axis.

parts.label: (ii)

parts.text:
Determine the gradient and y‑intercept of this line.
gradient = ______
y‑intercept = ______

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
It is suggested that the quantities e and θ are related by the equation
e = P sinθ + Q
where P and Q are constants.
Using your answers in (e)(iii), determine the values of P and Q.
Give appropriate units.
P = ______
Q = ______

text: In this experiment, you will investigate the equilibrium position of a wooden strip.
Some of the apparatus has been set up for you.

board

• Set up the apparatus as shown in Fig. 2.2.
stand
clamp

Fig. 2.2
• Ensure the rods of the clamps are the same height above the bench.
• Slide the rods of the clamps through the holes in the board as shown in Fig. 2.2.
Ensure that each end of the board touches a stand.
• The distance between the inside edges of the stands is d, as shown in Fig. 2.2.
Adjust the apparatus until d is in the range 92 cm to 99 cm.
• Measure and record d.
d = ______ cm

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Estimate the percentage uncertainty in your value of d. Show your working.
percentage uncertainty = ______%

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
• Place the spring in the middle of the curved board.
• Displace the spring a short distance to one side, as shown in Fig. 2.3.
spring
board
Fig. 2.3
• Release the spring. The spring will roll from side to side on the board.
• Take measurements to determine the period T of these oscillations.
T = ______ s

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
• Adjust the apparatus until d is in the range 66 cm to 74 cm. Ensure that the board does
not touch the bench.
• Measure and record d.
d = ______ cm
• Repeat (c).
T = ______ s

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
It is suggested that the relationship between T and d is
(T – a) = kd
where a is 0.70 s and k is a constant.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Using your data, calculate two values of k.
first value of k = ______
second value of k = ______

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Justify the number of significant figures that you have given for your values of k.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
It is suggested that the percentage uncertainty in the values of k is 10%.
Using this uncertainty, explain whether your results support the relationship in (e).

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Describe four sources of uncertainty or limitations of the procedure for this experiment.
For any uncertainties in measurement that you describe, you should state the quantity
being measured and a reason for the uncertainty.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Describe four improvements that could be made to this experiment. You may suggest
the use of other apparatus or different procedures.
